description: Import a DICOM folder into a BIDS dataset with BIDSvue's import pipeline, without a window: dcm2niix (or another importer), BIDSvue's post-pass cleanup, then the dataset under the step's output directory. Same output and handoff as the interactive bidsvue tool, with settings taken from the inputs instead of the user.

subject.description: BIDS subject label (default: from the DICOM PatientID).

anonymize.description: Also strip dates from the sidecars (dcm2niix -ba y).

block.label: Ingest with BIDSvue (no window)
block.description: Import DICOMs into BIDS with BIDSvue's pipeline and fixed settings.

requirements: BIDSvue checkout (bidsui, branch neuroflow/window-ingest until niivue/BIDSvue#18 merges, then main) beside NeuroFlow or via NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_BIDSVUE, with `bun install` run in it (the package script runs `svelte-kit sync` from node_modules)
dcm2niix for BIDSvue: its staged sidecar, DCM2NIIX, or PATH
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs `bun run neuroflow-ingest --neuroflow-session $NEUROFLOW_SESSION` (BIDSvue's package script: `svelte-kit sync`, then `scripts/neuroflow-ingest.ts`) in the BIDSvue checkout, after `--check` confirms it is ready, which imports inputs.dicom_dir into $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR/bids and writes neuroflow.handoff.json and its provenance line.

probe.advice: run `bun install` in the BIDSvue checkout and stage its dcm2niix sidecar, or set DCM2NIIX

useWhen: Convert a DICOM folder (a whole session, any number of series) into a BIDS dataset with nobody at the machine.
An agent or unattended workflow needs BIDSvue's import, including its post-pass cleanup, with every setting given as an input.

avoidWhen.when: A person should choose series, check metadata or correct BIDS names during the import.
You need one NIfTI volume from one series, not a BIDS dataset.
The sequence names follow ReproIn and the study wants HeuDiConv's reproin layout exactly.

preconditions: A BIDSvue checkout with `bun install` run in it, beside NeuroFlow or via NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_BIDSVUE, and bun on PATH or via BUN.
dcm2niix available to BIDSvue (its staged sidecar, DCM2NIIX, or PATH). The step runs `bun run neuroflow-ingest --check` first and stops if it is not ready.
effects: Writes the BIDS dataset to <output dir>/bids and returns it as bids_dir, plus neuroflow.handoff.json and a provenance line.
Never overwrites an existing dataset: the step fails if <output dir>/bids already exists.
subject defaults to the DICOM PatientID. anonymize strips dates from the sidecars; shift_dates moves acquisition dates to 1925-01-01.

duration.basis: Measured: 53-60 s for one Siemens session of 35 series on an Apple-silicon Mac; grows with the number of series.

examples.title: Import a session with the defaults

failures.meaning: BIDSvue's readiness check failed: usually dcm2niix or the checkout's node_modules is missing.
failures.remedy: The message lists the problems. Install or point to the missing piece (DCM2NIIX, BUN, NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_BIDSVUE) and run `bun install` in the checkout.
Clone niivue/BIDSvue beside NeuroFlow, or set NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_BIDSVUE to the checkout.

failures.meaning: The output directory already holds a dataset from an earlier run.
failures.remedy: Run the step in a fresh session, or remove the earlier output first.

failures.meaning: BIDSvue exited cleanly but did not write the declared outputs.
failures.remedy: Read the step log for the importer's messages; check that dicom_dir holds image series.
